name: Results analysis
description: Fit dose-response curves (four-parameter), read samples off a standard curve and compare groups with the right test, from rows of data. Gives the numbers and a plot.
author: Sheetbase

operations.title: Analyse results
operations.description: Analyses rows of results: the numbers, a plain summary and an SVG plot. kind dose_response fits a four-parameter curve per group (EC50 with 95% interval, slope, bottom, top, R²) from a dose and a response column. kind standard_curve fits rows with a known value in x and reads the rows without one off the curve (for example DNA concentration). kind compare_groups compares y between the groups in group (Welch t-test, or ANOVA with Tukey).

inputs.name: rows
inputs.description: The data: a list of objects, one per row, keyed by column name.

inputs.name: x
inputs.description: dose_response: the dose column. standard_curve: the known value column (blank for samples to read).

inputs.name: y
inputs.description: The response or signal column (the values compared for compare_groups).

inputs.name: group
inputs.description: dose_response: a column that splits the rows into one curve each. compare_groups: the column naming the groups.

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: standard_curve: a column naming each sample.

inputs.name: unit
inputs.description: dose_response: the dose unit for the axis, such as nM.
